theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_ga_relative_lipschitz_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (F L : Euclid n → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid n)) (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 ≤ b → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, a * ‖L x - L y‖ ≤ ‖F x - F y‖ ∧ ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ b * ‖L x - L y‖) → ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ n) * μHE[n] (L '' S) ≤ μHE[n] (F '' S) ∧ μHE[n] (F '' S) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ n) * μHE[n] (L '' S)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
